formalSequence: target === null => reject TARGET_NULL before RR exists
otherwise RR contributes to PriorityScore and tie-break

semanticFirewall.TARGET_NULL: target geometry/provenance failure; RR is undefined and must remain UNKNOWN
semanticFirewall.LOW_RR: target exists and risk is positive, but computed RR is below 2
semanticFirewall.rule: Never pool TARGET_NULL with LOW_RR as an RR<2 cohort and never coerce undefined RR to 0.

falsificationQuestions: Does TARGET_NULL rejection protect against poor path quality after controlling channel, ATR, sector/regime and liquidity?
Does LOW_RR rejection add downside/path information after target source, stop geometry and ATR controls?
Are TARGET_NULL cases concentrated in B new-high structures because priorHigh20 cannot be a target above breakout entry?
Does optional targetPrice materially flip target-null or RR status, and is its provenance PIT-safe?
Do coarse local pivots or the fixed >1% eligibility band create false-conservative or false-optimistic target geometry?
antiBias: No historical targetPrice backfill from later-known data
Preserve exact first rejection reason and per-reason denominator
Do not threshold-sweep RR or 1% target band before prospective evidence matures
Control transaction cost, liquidity, channel, ATR/stop binding state, sector/regime and date clustering
Check redundancy versus setupQuality, ATR, sector/RS and target-source state

engineering.classAOnlyIf: receipt reuses already-computed same-scan objects with zero extra market calls and leaves Formal outputs invariant
engineering.downgradeToClassBIf: shared enrichment/storage/runtime scheduling or source-fetch semantics must change

exactNext: After reason-stratified Shadow/version-line reconciliation, prospectively serialize separate TARGET_NULL and LOW_RR receipts plus RR-passed controls; then measure date-clustered incidence and outcomes without changing thresholds.
